column3: Note 1: The control region consists of PCFICH, PHICH and PDCCH.Note 2: DCI formats are defined in TS 36.212.Note 3: DCI format shall depend upon the test configuration.Note 4: Cell ID shall depend upon the test configuration.Note 5: Payload size shall depend upon the test configuration.Note 6: For PDCCH using SI/RA/P-RNTI, Aggregation level 4 is used.
